summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI data-center physical-infrastructure node found one high-attention reference leader and three more direct underfollowed candidates. The strongest direct evidence is for Vertiv as the public-market reference leader in critical digital infrastructure, Powell Industries as a switchgear/electrical-distribution supplier with unusually large data-center orders, nVent as a liquid-cooling and power-distribution supplier tied to AI rack-density shifts, and IES Holdings as a data-center electrical/infrastructure installation and custom-engineered-solutions beneficiary. This is a research universe, not a recommendation.
